criteria_results.criterion_text: Marking the second step `passed` and reloading reports it `passed`
criteria_results.evidence: Implemented update_step_status method with transactional integrity. Test TestUpdateStepStatus::test_marking_second_step_passed_persists verifies that marking step 1 as passed persists correctly while steps 0 and 2 remain pending.

criteria_results.criterion_text: Advancing from the first step and reloading puts the pointer on the
criteria_results.evidence: Implemented advance method that increments current_step_index by one. Test TestAdvanceRunbook::test_advancing_from_first_step_moves_to_second verifies the pointer moves from 0 to 1.

criteria_results.criterion_text: A step set to `awaiting_approval` persists and reloads as such
criteria_results.evidence: Test TestAwaitingApprovalStatus::test_awaiting_approval_status_persists verifies that StepStatus.awaiting_approval can be set via update_step_status and persists across reload.

criteria_results.criterion_text: Each of the five `StepStatus` values can be set on a step and read
criteria_results.evidence: Test TestAllStepStatusValues uses parametrize to test all five StepStatus values (pending, running, passed, failed, awaiting_approval), verifying each can be set and read back.

criteria_results.criterion_text: A step result round-trips its exit code, captured output, and
criteria_results.evidence: Test TestStepResultRoundTrip::test_step_result_round_trips_all_fields verifies that StepResult with exit_code, captured_output, started_at, and completed_at all round-trip through update_step_status with result parameter.

criteria_results.criterion_text: The resume pointer can occupy positions 0..2 across a three-step
criteria_results.evidence: Test TestResumePointerPositions uses parametrize to verify the resume pointer can be at positions 0, 1, and 2 for a three-step runbook, and each position survives reload.

criteria_results.criterion_text: The resume pointer survives the store being closed and reopened
criteria_results.evidence: Test TestResumePointerPersistence::test_resume_pointer_survives_reopen creates a runbook, advances it, closes the connection, reopens with a new connection, and verifies the pointer remains at position 1.

criteria_results.criterion_text: Updating a step position out of range raises
criteria_results.evidence: Implemented RunbookStepNotFoundError. Test TestOutOfRangeStepRejected::test_out_of_range_sequence_index_raises_error verifies that attempting to update sequence_index=1 on a single-step runbook raises the error and leaves the existing step unchanged.

Implemented Python-side validation that raises RunbookValidationError before the SQL write if status is not a StepStatus member. Test TestUnrecognisedStatusRejected::test_unrecognised_status_raises_validation_error verifies invalid status raises error and previous status is preserved.

criteria_results.criterion_text: Advancing past the final step raises `RunbookAdvanceError` and
criteria_results.evidence: Implemented RunbookAdvanceError. Test TestAdvancePastFinalStepRejected::test_advancing_past_final_step_raises_error verifies that advancing from the last step (index 0 in a 1-step runbook) raises the error and leaves pointer and status unchanged.
Test TestAdvanceUnknownRunbookRejected::test_advancing_nonexistent_runbook_raises_error verifies that calling advance on a non-existent runbook_id raises RunbookNotFoundError.

criteria_results.criterion_text: The overall status set at create round-trips across all five values
criteria_results.evidence: Test TestOverallStatusNotMutated uses parametrize to verify that for each of the five StepStatus values, when set as the overall runbook status at creation, it remains unchanged after update_step_status and advance operations (ASSUM-009).

criteria_results.criterion_text: All modified files pass project-configured lint/format checks with
criteria_results.evidence: Ran black formatter and ruff linter. All files pass: 'All checks passed!' from ruff, and black reformatted one file with no errors.

Following TDD RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycle: (1) Wrote comprehensive test suite covering all 13 test classes with parametrized tests. (2) Implemented update_step_status and advance methods. (3) All 35 tests pass including 2 seam tests. Tests were written before implementation per TDD discipline.
